(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 hole (D12) is a tight-tolerance fit feature, but the drawing specifies an I.Z.B.P. plating treatment without any note or dimension allowance for the plating thickness. The added plating will reduce the bore diameter and can prevent assembly with the mating shaft; the designer must either increase the hole size to compensate for the coating or add a note specifying that the H7 tolerance applies after plating.","recommended_correction":"Add a note stating the H7 tolerance applies after plating, or adjust the pre-plate hole size to account for the specified I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
